critical_boundaries.fact: availablePorts can call isValidSerial8250 in both udev and sysfs branches. That helper opens the character device O_RDWR|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOCTTY, issues TIOCGSERIAL, then closes it.
critical_boundaries.conclusion: QSerialPortInfo::availablePorts is not a strict zero-open API on Linux. Do not invoke it in the current no-serial-open local-settings slice.
critical_boundaries.qualification: Upstream static source evidence; native and inspected ARM sysroots have no Qt5 SerialPort binary, so no local runtime implementation was exercised.

critical_boundaries.fact: availablePorts uses SetupAPI/CM and read/query registry APIs; CreateFile for a COM device appears in separate isBusy/isValid methods.
critical_boundaries.conclusion: Optional Windows QtSerialPort use must never add isBusy/isValid/open checks. It adds a DLL dependency unnecessary for candidate names.

critical_boundaries.fact: The explicit registry-path QSettings constructor uses read_only=false; obtaining a handle can request KEY_READ|KEY_WRITE and fall back to RegCreateKeyEx.
critical_boundaries.conclusion: QSettings NativeFormat is not a strict no-registry-create enumeration adapter even if application code only requests childKeys/value.

root_selected_minimal_adapter.linux: QtCore/OS sysfs and /dev path metadata/stat only; never open a character device, call ioctl, write, or derive baud/connection readiness. Return candidate names in the store worker with an injectable anonymous provider.
root_selected_minimal_adapter.windows: Use fixed HKLM\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP\SERIALCOMM with RegOpenKeyExW(KEY_QUERY_VALUE), RegEnumValueW, RegCloseKey; no RegCreate/Set, QSettings registry constructor, QSerialPort open/isBusy/isValid, socket or listener.
root_selected_minimal_adapter.windows_link: win32: LIBS += -ladvapi32 explicitly if direct WinAPI calls are selected; this is a system import, no third-party runtime or system DLL copy.
root_selected_minimal_adapter.candidate_semantics: Candidate presence is not port availability, access permission, connection success or LIS readiness. Preserve missing saved names, allow a genuine empty list, and keep TCP/serial drafts independently. No guessed endpoint/client-server/parity/baud defaults.
root_selected_minimal_adapter.stop_boundary: Run enumeration outside GUI and do not promise bounded cancellation of a blocked OS metadata/registry operation without separate proof.
